prerequisites: Knowledge from basic subjects of mechanical engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Develop and manufacture a machine from scratch.
Adhere to planning, production, and release processes.
Formulate ideas and elaborate them in a team.
Apply knowledge acquired in any other subjects of their studies to a complex task.
Cooperate with people outside the team (workshop, supervisors, suppliers).
Work under time and cost pressure.

syllabus_topics: Design and manufacture of a machine with mechatronic aspects based on a given requirements list
Competition of the machines among themselves
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon presentation of a machine on the competition day and submission of documentation. The weighting of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
bibliography: Access to the equipment of the laboratories and teaching centers of the Department of Mechanical Engineering
